description:
There is one "hydrocarbons, unspecified" in the world -- a bucket for an emission somebody measured as hydrocarbons and did not speciate -- and EF 3.1 publishes it as `Hydrocarbons (unspecified)` in fourteen contexts, characterised in most of them. ecoinvent 3.12 ships the bucket on nine rows as `Hydrocarbons, unspecified`, with no registry number; seven are in ecoinvent's own correspondence table and reach EF's substance that way. The two the table omits -- air, unspecified and agricultural soil -- had only the name to match on, the name differs from EF's by a comma and a pair of brackets, and on the 2026-08-29 build of `54b0f9d` they minted a second substance, `Hydrocarbons, Unspecified`, with no factor. BAFU 2026 v1's five rows of the same name, in air and four water bodies, then joined the copy rather than the original: seven rows on a duplicate, which the issue -- written from ecoinvent's side -- counted as two.

The fix is seven curated targets: two in `ecoinvent-match-overrides.json` onto EF's flows in the rows' own contexts, five in `bafu-2026-v1-match-overrides.json` onto EF's air, water, sea-water and fresh-water flows. EF has no lake and no river, so the two BAFU rows there name EF's fresh-water flow for the substance it carries, and the merge -- which refuses to publish a lake as fresh water, since that is a different named water body rather than a vaguer one -- keeps each row's own water body and mints the bucket's flow there, as it does for every substance BAFU reports to a lake or a river (#84, #85).

A synonym written onto EF's fourteen rows was tried first and does not work: measured on the build of 2026-08-30 at `53c2165`, no row moved, because `bootstrap_labels` deletes a base-list row's synonyms before the merge builds the label index. See #178.

expectations.title: ecoinvent's Hydrocarbons, unspecified in air reaches EF's flow in air
expectations.comment: The first of the two rows the issue names. EF carries the bucket in `Emissions to air, unspecified` already -- `d86b9e8a` -- so this is an exact-context landing on a flow that exists. `outcome: prepared` because a curated target is what decides it, the same route as the seven rows the vendor's table covers. Rewritten from `algorithm` on `basis: label` once the synonym route was measured not to work; the id is kept because the question is the same.

expectations.title: ecoinvent's Hydrocarbons, unspecified in agricultural soil reaches EF's flow there
expectations.comment: The second. EF's `d86b9e73` is the bucket in `Emissions to agricultural soil`, again an exact context.

expectations.title: All nine of ecoinvent 3.12's Hydrocarbons, unspecified rows reach one substance
expectations.comment: Seven by the vendor's table and two by curated rows, all on EF's substance. The seven held before and must go on holding: a curated row exists only for the two the table omits, and this is what says so.

expectations.title: BAFU's five Hydrocarbons, unspecified rows reach EF's substance too
expectations.comment: The rows the issue did not count. BAFU ships the bucket in air, unspecified and in four water bodies -- lake, river, ocean and unspecified -- and all five reached the minted copy on its label. The substance is claimed for the group and nothing about the route: three land on EF's flows as `prepared`, and the lake and river rows are recorded as `algorithm` because the merge minted the bucket's flow in their water body rather than publish them on EF's fresh water. A first draft claimed `prepared` for all five and failed on the build of 2026-08-30 at ed019c6 for that reason. The two minted rows are claimed on their own below.

expectations.title: BAFU's hydrocarbons to a lake are published to a lake, on EF's substance
expectations.comment: The curated row names EF's fresh-water flow, and the merge keeps the lake: fresh water is a different named water body, not a vaguer one, so publishing the row on it would say something BAFU denied (#85), and the bucket gets a lake flow the way every other substance BAFU reports to a lake does. Both halves are claimed -- the substance and the compartment -- because a curated row that coarsened the lake to fresh water would meet the group claim above and be wrong.

expectations.title: BAFU's hydrocarbons to a river are published to a river, on EF's substance
There is no second hydrocarbons bucket
expectations.comment: The negative half. Stated as an absence because nothing renames the duplicate: it stops being created once no row is left to mint it.
